7274.title: Unicode query casing changes path recall
7274.rootCauseOneLine: Path matching explicitly uses smart-case, so uppercase Cyrillic queries exclude lowercase candidates; the same policy also affects ASCII.
7274.proposedFix: Choose the intended path case policy, then apply it consistently to plain, structured, prefix-tail, and comparison matching.
7274.caveats: Matcher-boundary reproduction on Linux, not macOS UI or HTTP verification. No automatic PR: changing explicit path smart-case requires a product-policy decision.
